note: Forbidden: a padding octet that is not zero. TestRFC7011PaddingIsZero asserts the 3 padding octets after a 53-octet IPv4 flow record are 0; TestRFC7011PaddingZeroedOverGarbage pre-fills the buffer with 0xFF and asserts the same octets are 0, red if writeFlowDataSet skips the zeroing. The IPv6 flow Set shares writeFlowDataSet, and the counter Set (32-octet records) never pads.
